findings.issue: Every positionName case (3, 4, 6, 9 seats) and every scenario (FLOP_BET, SEAT_1_DEALT, default) puts the button on the highest seat, so the rotation from the button is never exercised.
findings.evidence: Mutant in table-view.ts:86 `const order = [...seats]` (button ignored) passes all 15 tests in table-view.test.ts, table-display.acceptance.test.tsx and table.acceptance.test.tsx. The real code is correct: a probe gives the right names for buttons 1-6 at 6-max (e.g. button 3 -> 1 Hijack, 2 Cutoff, 3 Button, 4 Small blind, 5 Big blind, 6 Under the gun) and sensible names at 3-10.
findings.fix: Add at least one case with the button not on the last seat, ideally all six buttons at 6-max, e.g. expect(names([1,2,3,4,5,6], 3)).toEqual(['Hijack','Cutoff','Button','Small blind','Big blind','Under the gun']).

findings.issue: The record() helper sets added = amount, and the only raise in the scripted hand is the user's open raise from 0 (amount 8, added 8). No test can tell 'Raised to $<amount>' (the raise-to total, spec section 5) from 'Raised to $<added>'.
findings.evidence: Mutant table-view.ts:67 `Raised to $${record.added}` passes all Vitest tests.
findings.fix: Give the raise record a different added value (e.g. {type:'raise', amount: 8, added: 4} -> 'Raised to $8'), or assert the text of a big blind that raised preflop.

findings.issue: Rule 2 says the action line shows the latest record on the current street. No asserted state has a seat with two records on the same street, so taking the first record instead of the last is never caught.
findings.evidence: Mutant table-view.ts:134 `.at(0)` instead of `.at(-1)` passes all Vitest tests. In the existing big-blind test, seat 1 (small blind, then call) would show 'Small blind $2' instead of 'Called $2', but seat 1 is not asserted.
findings.fix: In 'the big blind to act with no raise...' also assert seatOf({...table, hand}, 1).action === 'Called $2'.

findings.issue: A-8 and the rule `line = 'river' when street === 'showdown'` say that after the hand the seats keep their last river action. The tests only check that 'Waiting' and 'To act' are absent at SHOWDOWN, so dropping the showdown->river mapping (every non-folded seat goes blank) is not caught.
findings.evidence: Mutant table-view.ts:133 `const line = view.street` passes all Vitest tests. No e2e test asserts the seat texts after Hand over.

findings.issue: D-3/Q-2 says 'This street $X' is shown only when it is above $0. Nothing checks that the line is absent at $0.
findings.evidence: Mutant Table.tsx:18 `seat.streetAmount >= 0` (renders 'This street $0' on every seat, including before the deal) passes all 31 tests in tests/table/table-view.test.ts and tests/ui/.
findings.fix: In the folded-bot or SPEC-01 test, assert part(seatItem(flop, 6).body, 'street') is null (Eli, $0 this street) and part(seatItem(flop, 1).body, 'street') is null; optionally also that render(seatSession()) contains no data-part="street".

findings.issue: `?? 0` after the table.stacks lookup is defensive code for a seat missing from table.stacks, which seatSession never produces (it is also the one uncovered branch).
findings.evidence: Coverage in gates/build-1.json reports table-view.ts branch line 160 uncovered.
findings.fix: Optional: leave as is, or use a non-null lookup helper. No behaviour change.

summary: The implementation matches the spec. tableView reads the hand only through playerView(hand, userSeat) and never reads replayCode. lastActionText and the four action-line rules (with A-8) are correct. Position names are correct for every button at 6-max and sensible at 3-10 (probe run). Pot = pots + street contributions. There is exactly one seat-to-act with a visible 'To act' badge, the dealer disc sits at the button, the seat slots run clockwise from the user, who sits at the bottom centre, and the header text is exact. Leave table returns Home with the h1 focused. CardBack small is 30x42 and the default stays 60x84. BotStyle keeps 'TAG'. The cross-story diffs to e2e/table.spec.ts, e2e/action-bar.spec.ts, e2e/home.spec.ts and tests/ui/table.acceptance.test.tsx are exactly the 8 D-5 edits plus one expectToAct import in each e2e file. The targeted Vitest files pass, and Playwright passes 60/60 (table-display, table, action-bar, home, cards; Chromium + WebKit). The screenshots match Q-3 (Eli lower left, Ava upper left, Ben top, Cal upper right, Dee lower right, D at Eli, red border and To act on the user). Test strength is the gap: 5 of 15 mutants survived the Vitest suite. They are button rotation in positionName, raise-to vs added, latest record per street, keeping the river action at showdown, and hiding the street line at $0. Each needs one or two added assertions. Mutants ran in a scratch copy outside the repo, in the session scratchpad.
